note: Fail-closed per-gate cardinality contracts for packs/ash-pplan-store-conformance-pack.
Keyed by GATE STEM (gates/NNN_stem.rq -> "stem"), not filename.
Every contract is PREDICATE-anchored: the anchor's own blind spot (total loss of the
anchor predicate) is exactly what the companion verify/*.unbound.rq queries name, so
contract + companion have disjoint blind spots.
"laws" is anchored on scb:statement (a required conjunct), not scb:lawId.
"covers" emits one row per scb:covers edge, so VALUES on the edge predicate.
"mutants" has no dedicated gate (the court consumes it via the suite bindings), so its
cardinality is anchored on scb:brokenCallback via the unbound companion only.
